principle: Capture inspiration opportunities without promoting every render into canon

graph.identity: stable work ID plus immutable artifact version/digest

retention.default: record reference and digest when authorized; do not duplicate all media
retention.ephemeral: skip when private, unconsented, redundant, low-value or transient
retention.promotion: requires evidence and a qualified reviewer or authorized policy
retention.deletion: respect retention limits and source permissions

cross_media_rule: A diagram can inspire a test and a test can invalidate a diagram; neither may certify its own evidence
email_rule: Evidence changes may mark a draft stale; never auto-send or silently rewrite sent mail
anti_silo_rule: Link typed references across permitted boundaries; do not merge private custody into public graph
minimum_proof: one nested map renders from source graph
one click opens source and preserves identity
one changed claim marks dependent media stale
one unauthorized media capture is rejected
one restart restores graph and navigation context
